import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv.pop(1))
import indeces
from indeces import console
from indeces.knowledge_directory import show_knowledge_directory
assert indeces.__version__=='0.9.2'
assert Path(indeces.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(sys.path[0]).resolve())
console.show_knowledge_directory=lambda cfg: show_knowledge_directory(cfg,open_directory=False)
def forbidden(*args,**kwargs):
    raise AssertionError('Service/model/credentials cannot be used in the progress reader')
console.run=console.OpenAIAdapter=console.prompt_secret=forbidden
console.main()
